title: CFSafety: Comprehensive Fine-grained Safety Assessment for LLMs

bias_targets.target: Social bias (including Gender, Racial, Religious, and Sexual Orientation bias)
bias_targets.methodology: Incorporating bias-related questions from the BBQ (Bias Benchmark for QA) dataset and evaluating model responses using an LLM-as-a-judge framework, which assigns a moral judgment score (0-1) and a safety rating (1-5) based on the weighted sum of output token probabilities.
